first.rationale: Targeted promotional pricing most directly addresses the immediate loss of price-sensitive SMBs and has prior acquisition and revenue evidence. Verify its qualification, retention, and post-promotion economics against the strongest activation and onboarding alternatives before committing; use a guarded test because durable downstream value is not established in the summary.

final.rationale: Run a standard shortened-onboarding experiment. It directly addresses the 4% completion decline and has confirmed gains in completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, making it the strongest option for sustainable qualified revenue. Activation messaging is credible but showed a smaller retention benefit. Promotional pricing is rejected because its 12% retention decline undermines long-term value despite near-term revenue lift.
